title: Polman Bandung and CNC Controller Indonesia
bottom_line: Politeknik Manufaktur Bandung (Polman) is a state polytechnic founded under a 1973 Indonesia-Switzerland agreement and run since 2018 as a public service agency (BLU) under the higher-education ministry, so it has no shareholders. PT Polman Didaktik Indonesia holds the TKDN certificate (42.08%) for the PODIK KHD40 mill that Polman launched in April 2026, but no public source names its owners or officers and it is not on Polman's 2026 org chart, so its tie to Polman is an inference from the shared name, brand and model. Polman's confirmed machine partner is PT CNC Controller Indonesia of Bekasi (director Farkhan; founded 2004 by its own account), which built the VMC 400 (2021) and MTU 200 pro (2022) with Polman on education-ministry Matching Fund grants, sells AMCOTRAIN-branded trainers and is called a sister company by trading firm PT AMCO Global Indonesia. No equity stake or investor was found anywhere in this web; named buyers are mostly Polman's training clients (Pupuk Kaltim, PERURI, Inalum, polytechnics) and, for ITS-designed MTU trainers that CNC Controller probably builds, East Java regencies and Politeknik Negeri Jember.

entities.name: Polman Bandung
entities.what: State manufacturing polytechnic (Dago campus) founded under the 6 Dec 1973 Indonesia-Swiss agreement as PMS-ITB; classes since 1976; a public service agency (BLU) since 15 Mar 2018, so it has no shareholders; designs, casts and sells CNC milling machines.

entities.name: Polman Bandung Kampus 2 Majalengka (PSDKU)
entities.what: Second campus on 30 ha at Jatipamor, Panyingkiran: a national strategic project under Perpres 87/2021 (Rebana); Technopole (19,301 m2) and I-SMART (2,387 m2) buildings; D3 machine maintenance, D4 manufacturing design and D4 automation.

entities.name: Divisi Pengembangan Bisnis (DPB)
entities.what: Polman's internal business division (formerly Badan Pengelola Usaha, BPU), set up by Director's Regulation 001/2026; sells production, training, testing and consulting through polman.com. Not a company.

entities.name: PT Polman Didaktik Indonesia
entities.what: Bandung firm at Jl. PSM 31, Kiaracondong (not Polman's Dago campus), KBLI 28221 (metal-working machine tools); holds the TKDN certificate for the PODIK KHD40 CNC mill (42.08%). Owners and officers not found.

entities.name: PODIK (KHD40 / KHD 40E CNC mill)
entities.what: Brand of Polman's KHD 40E education CNC mill (BT30, 6,000 rpm, 12-tool magazine, Siemens control, ~80% made in-house); launched 22 Apr 2026; research since 2016.

entities.name: PT CNC Controller Indonesia (CNC Indonesia Machine Works)
entities.what: Special-purpose machine maker and system integrator (says founded 2004, 20 staff incl. 15 engineers); makes MTU/LTU CNC training units; TKDN 41.89% for its BIMA VMC (brand AMCOTRAIN); KBLI 28221.

entities.name: PT AMCO Global Indonesia (AMCO Group)
entities.what: Trading company 'Asia Mechatronic Cooperation' (says est. 2004): industrial machinery, parts and education solutions; calls PT CNC Controller Indonesia its sister company; no Kemenperin or TKDN record found.

entities.name: AMCOTRAIN
entities.what: Brand on CNC Controller Indonesia's TKDN-certified BIMA VMC (41.89%) and on a Bima VMC-650 listed at Rp1.17bn.

entities.name: AMCOTECH (808M controller)
entities.what: Controller brand ('AMCOTECH 808M', with cloud monitoring) on the Polman-CNC Controller MTU 200 pro version; maker not stated.

entities.name: PT Gudang Solusi Acommerce
entities.what: Vendor on UNPMALL (Universitas Negeri Padang's procurement mall) listing an Amcotrain Bima VMC-650 (Rp1,170,000,000) plus LTU 150 and Pandawa 200TM CNC lathes.

entities.name: ITS (MMTDC / Mechatronics Technology Centre)
entities.what: State university whose Mechatronic and Machine Tool Design Development Center (ITS-MMTDC, launched 2013; called MTC by 2015) designs MTU/LTU mini-CNC trainers that an industry partner builds.

entities.name: Kabupaten Situbondo (regency government)
entities.what: Regency that ordered ITS MTU mini-CNC units; 10 delivered by Dec 2015.

entities.name: Politeknik Negeri Jember
entities.what: State polytechnic that received 2 ITS MTU CNC units (Dec 2015).

entities.name: Kabupaten Magetan (regency government)
entities.what: One of three regencies that ordered 100 ITS mini-CNC units in 2016 (split not given).

entities.what: One of three regencies that ordered 100 ITS mini-CNC units in 2016 (split not given).

entities.name: PT AHM

entities.name: Siemens (SINUMERIK CNC controls)
entities.what: Siemens control is a bought-in part of the KHD 40E; SINUMERIK 808D HMI on CNC Controller's 2018 MTU 200; 828D/810D controls on Polman workshop machines.

entities.name: Swiss Confederation
entities.what: Co-founded PMS-ITB under the 6 Dec 1973 bilateral agreement; supplied teaching materials, equipment, workshops and experts from 1976.

entities.name: Swisscontact
entities.what: Swiss development foundation appointed Swiss executor of the PMS-ITB project.

entities.name: SECO (State Secretariat for Economic Affairs)
entities.what: Swiss agency funding the Renewable Energy Skills Development (RESD) project; Phase II (Oct 2025 to end-2028) includes Polman.

entities.name: Institut Teknologi Bandung (ITB)
entities.what: Indonesian executor of the Swiss project; PMS-ITB came out of ITB's non-degree faculty and stayed under ITB until it became independent (1998 per Polman).

entities.name: Kemdiktisaintek
entities.legal_name: Kementerian Pendidikan Tinggi, Sains, dan Teknologi
